associated_studies: Legagneux et al. 2012 Proc R Soc B 10.1098/rspb.2011.1351

purpose: Determine whether public Dryad files permit a source-faithful reanalysis that isolates a duration-dependent D-like perturbation axis more narrowly than the published all-treatment summary.

preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.primary_subset: fed-captivity birds plus immediate-release controls; exclude fasting treatment from primary
preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.exposure: captivity/delay duration fixed before reproductive outcome
preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.rationale: remove deliberate energetic deprivation while retaining elapsed captivity duration; confinement/handling stress remains a stated residual confound
preregistered_next_design_if_fields_exis.primary_claim_ceiling: duration-dependent reproductive carry-over under fed/control conditions is a D-like time/stress calibration, not pure PAYOFF-B opportunity cost D
forbidden: do not select years based on effect significance
do not use 2009 only as primary because it has the strongest published effect
do not call captivity hours natural waiting cost D
do not combine with GPS q_wait outcome before a separate joint preregistration
do not use the 2009-only public Dryad as a substitute primary duration-fitness test because 2009 is already known to be a strong published effect year

gate: Inspect public file manifest and documentation before freezing exact columns, endpoint, random effects, and uncertainty estimator.

public_2026_same_experiment_source.associated_article: Grentzmann et al. 2025/2026 Ecology and Evolution, DOI 10.1002/ece3.71812
key_fields: Young autumn young-presence with NA for females not reobserved
capture histories and E-SURGE treatment/day covariates
public_2026_same_experiment_source.assignment_unit: capture group, not individual; treatment groups were assigned in a randomly predefined order
public_2026_same_experiment_source.reason: the public source covers 2009 only, already known from the published 3-year analysis to be a strong carry-over-effect year; promoting a 2009-only duration-fitness analysis would violate the frozen rule against choosing the strongest published year

public_2026_mechanistic_use.role: J-like mechanism decomposition only, not natural D_eff calibration
public_2026_mechanistic_use.permitted_primary: within fed captive birds, test whether longer captivity changes post-treatment body-condition loss while deliberate fasting is absent
public_2026_mechanistic_use.exposure: DaysInCap, 2-4 days, assigned at capture-group level
public_2026_mechanistic_use.response: body-condition change from cond2009_July2024 joined to treatment/duration through Collar and UNIKCAPT
public_2026_mechanistic_use.uncertainty: capture-group clustered; individual n must not be treated as treatment-level replication
minimum_gate: at least 2 distinct nonzero captivity durations and preferably all 2/3/4-day levels
at least 30 fed females with pre/post body-condition measurements
no outcome-based exclusion of capture groups
public_2026_mechanistic_use.secondary: CORT-at-release versus DaysInCap within fed birds may be descriptive only
public_2026_mechanistic_use.claim_ceiling: physiological/energetic direct-cost mechanism consistent with a J(delta) component; not fitness-equivalent J, not D_eff, not q_wait
